## 🌡️ MARKET ATMOSPHERE

**1. Global Risk Regime?**
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 5/11 sectors positive. SPY (1W: +1.11% | 1M: +5.71%) ABOVE TREND and VXX (1W: -5.68% | 1M: -22.72%) ↓ falling | BELOW TREND signal easing fear but only 5/11 breadth and neutral credit (HYG/LQD) keep the regime balanced.

**2. Primary Risk Drivers?**
Fear easing: VXX (1W: -5.68% | 1M: -22.72%) ↓ falling | BELOW TREND. Credit stable: HYG (1W: +0.39% | 1M: +1.28%) → flat | ABOVE TREND and LQD (1W: +0.63% | 1M: +0.92%) → flat | ABOVE TREND; equities strength via SPY (1W: +1.11% | 1M: +5.71%) ↑ rising | ABOVE TREND.

**3. Financial Conditions Signal?**
Neutral overall: UUP (1W: +0.39% | 1M: -1.41%) RECOVERY while TLT (1W: +0.96% | 1M: +0.74%) ABOVE TREND → flat; yield curve and duration preference remain broadly unchanged.

## 📈 EQUITIES & FLOWS

**4. Sector Leadership?**
Technology leading: XLK (1W: +3.01% | 1M: +13.23%) ABOVE TREND; Materials (1W: +1.69% | 1M: +6.61%) ABOVE TREND and Financials (1W: +1.50% | 1M: +2.42%) ABOVE TREND show cyclicals participation. Energy lagging and rotating: XLE (1W: -2.29% | 1M: +6.21%) CORRECTION — style: Growth/momentum showing leadership.

**5. US vs Global?**
US outperforms: SPY (1W: +1.11% | 1M: +5.71%) ABOVE TREND and QQQ (1W: +1.43% | 1M: +8.97%) ABOVE TREND; EM strength concentrated: EEM (1W: +1.49% | 1M: +10.71%) ABOVE TREND while China FXI (1W: -1.21% | 1M: -2.44%) BELOW TREND.

**6. Speculative Appetite?**
Speculative risk-on: IBIT (1W: +9.93% | 1M: +25.81%) ABOVE TREND and ARKK (1W: +4.94% | 1M: +23.80%) ABOVE TREND show strong flow into riskier beta; IWM (1W: +0.72% | 1M: +3.90%) ABOVE TREND confirms small-cap participation.

## 🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

**7. Commodities Theme?**
Precious metals leadership: GLD (1W: +1.77% | 1M: +13.88%) ABOVE TREND and SLV (1W: +1.80% | 1M: +21.25%) ABOVE TREND; industrial metals CPER (1W: +1.60% | 1M: +4.25%) ABOVE TREND supports cyclical tone.

**8. Energy Trend?**
Energy mixed to soft: XLE (1W: -2.29% | 1M: +6.21%) CORRECTION and BNO (1W: -3.33% | 1M: +2.54%) CORRECTION, while natural gas UNG (1W: +4.20% | 1M: +5.04%) ABOVE TREND — watch divergence between oil and gas.

## 🧭 STRATEGY

**9. Trend Confirmation?**
CONFIRMED: Core risk tape SPY (1W: +1.11% | 1M: +5.71%) ABOVE TREND, QQQ (1W: +1.43% | 1M: +8.97%) ABOVE TREND and XLK (1W: +3.01% | 1M: +13.23%) ABOVE TREND show aligned strength. DIVERGENCE: XLE (1W: -2.29% | 1M: +6.21%) and several sector correction alerts are minor divergences but worth monitoring.

**10. Portfolio Direction?**
Favor growth/momentum exposure via XLK (1W: +3.01% | 1M: +13.23%) ABOVE TREND and QQQ (1W: +1.43% | 1M: +8.97%) ABOVE TREND; reduce exposure to lagging energy XLE (1W: -2.29% | 1M: +6.21%) CORRECTION and China FXI (1W: -1.21% | 1M: -2.44%) BELOW TREND while keeping bond exposure stable.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Sectors to Watch?**
BULLISH: Technology XLK (1W: +3.01% | 1M: +13.23%) ABOVE TREND for momentum continuation and Materials (1W: +1.69% | 1M: +6.61%) ABOVE TREND for cyclicals. BEARISH: Energy XLE (1W: -2.29% | 1M: +6.21%) CORRECTION and Utilities XLU (1W: -1.35% | 1M: -3.85%) BELOW TREND for defensive weakness.

**12. Commodities to Watch?**
BULLISH: Silver SLV (1W: +1.80% | 1M: +21.25%) ABOVE TREND and Copper CPER (1W: +1.60% | 1M: +4.25%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: Brent BNO (1W: -3.33% | 1M: +2.54%) CORRECTION — oil weakness could pressure broader energy names.

**13. Key Levels?**
VXX (1W: -5.68% | 1M: -22.72%) BELOW TREND — watch a meaningful re-acceleration as a risk signal; HYG/LQD (HYG 1W: +0.39% | 1M: +1.28% ABOVE TREND; LQD 1W: +0.63% | 1M: +0.92% ABOVE TREND) — watch credit compression/expansion; XLK/ XLF ratio (monitor if XLK outperformance extends past current premium).

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL. Breadth: 5/11 sectors positive.  
Technology and growth momentum showing strength via XLK (1W: +3.01% | 1M: +13.23%) ABOVE TREND and QQQ (1W: +1.43% | 1M: +8.97%) ABOVE TREND; EM and commodities also contributing.  
Key risk: energy/China weakness (XLE 1W: -2.29% | 1M: +6.21% CORRECTION; FXI 1W: -1.21% | 1M: -2.44% BELOW TREND) could widen divergences if breadth deteriorates.
